purpose: Validate a genuinely three-dimensional variational tensor-AQUAL solver before constructing a photon deflection or reading any spent or sealed lensing outcome.
equation: div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) (I-sigma h_hat h_hat) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b
equivalent_tensor: mu[(1-sigma)I + sigma(n1 n1 + n2 n2)], with (h,n1,n2) orthonormal

definitions.sigma: bounded baryonic physical-length quadratic coherence coefficient
definitions.n1_n2: a deterministic orthonormal basis of the plane perpendicular to h_hat

solver.discretization: symmetric variational 3D graph with Cartesian isotropic links and trilinear plus/minus links along both perpendicular directions

selection_rule: The sole 3D tensor discretization advances to photon-deflection construction only if every mathematical, nonlinear, density-lift, parameter, and blindness gate passes.
claim_boundary: P0665 validates numerical machinery only; it does not establish a physical three-dimensional sigma construction or a relativistic metric.
The graph is a positive variational discretization of the stated elliptic equation, not a covariant action.
No spent RX J2129 image and no P0633/P0640 target may be used in P0665 development or selection.
